# CONSUMER_NON_CYCLICALS — 2026-W45 (week to 2026-11-07)

## Coverage changes

Four POULTRY_FEED initiations published 6 Nov: [CPIN](coverage/companies/CPIN.JK/report.md) BUY, target Rp3,650 against Rp2,370 (+63.3%); [JPFA](coverage/companies/JPFA.JK/report.md) BUY, Rp2,619 against Rp1,620 (+70.9%); [RLCO](coverage/companies/RLCO.JK/report.md) SELL, Rp1,112 against Rp2,250 (−50.6%); [AYAM](coverage/companies/AYAM.JK/report.md) SELL, Rp20 against Rp484 (−95.8%), where the swing to profit is a sale-and-leaseback gain, not an operating recovery. [PGUN](coverage/companies/PGUN.JK/report.md) updated 2 Nov, SELL, Rp4,210 against Rp8,025 (−47.4%), trimmed as the premium ratio fell; HSC-designated shares, PGUN among them, left the IHSG calculation that day. [NEST](coverage/companies/NEST.JK/report.md) is parked: its datapack share count is 1,000x wrong after the prelude rebuild; WMPP's adhoc is queued.

## Deck moves

The agri deck was unchanged this week (last reviewed 27 Oct). Spot-versus-forecast gaps widened: wheat US$218.07 against FY2027E US$293.5 (−25.7%), corn US$172.93 against US$214.57 (−19.4%), soymeal US$349.21 against US$411.0 (−15.0%) — feed inputs below the modelled path, a margin tailwind for CPIN and JPFA. CPO is the exception: the November reference price fell 6.07% to US$978.90/t, with duty US$124/t and a 12.5% levy (US$122.36/t), below the deck's FY2026E US$1,135 [deck S1]. The deck's CPO spot is still the September Pink Sheet print of US$1,180, so a refresh is due.

## Material news

The government fixed the single-window export route: from 1 Jan 2027 CPO, coal and ferro-alloy exports must pass through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia, capital base Rp4trn; its NADI portal pilots with 100 companies [triage 6 Nov](coverage/news/triage/2026-fund record). Fees await BP BUMN/Danantara approval; GAPKI warned of shipment delays and CPO stockpiling and projects 2027 output 2-3m tonnes lower on El Niño. Nine-month results: LSIP profit +40% to Rp1.74trn, SIMP +45% to Rp2.05trn, WMPP revenue +40% and back to profit, RLCO third quarter +19.1%. ULTJ is raising up to Rp16.94trn in a rights issue at Rp2,150 to fund the Rp14.57trn Frisian Flag purchase [triage 5-6 Nov].

## What to watch

The DSI fee decision; the December CPO reference price against the deck; whether grain spot converges to the higher FY2027E anchors; farm-gate broiler prices, still below cost; ULTJ's dilution after the 6 Nov EGM; and NEST's datapack fix so the initiation can restart.

*Research only; not a recommendation to act.*
